description: Source code for WebKitBrowser plugin implementation, including initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and event handling.

classes.name: WebKitBrowser
classes.description: Implementation of a web browser plugin handling web requests, browser state, and events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebKitBrowser plugin, sets up browser instance, and registers notifications.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases the browser instance.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests, particularly POST requests.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests, handles commands like suspend, resume, hide, show, and set URL.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Event handler for when a page load finishes.

methods.name: LoadFailed
methods.description: Event handler for when a page load fails.

methods.name: VisibilityChange
methods.description: Event handler for visibility state changes.

methods.name: BridgeQuery
methods.description: Event handler for bridge query messages.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Event handler for browser state changes.
